blocks.instructions:
Vessel Identification — PracticeOn each trial an acoustic signature appears on the display.
  • Click the matching vessel thumbnail at the bottom of the screen.
  • After your response, rate your confidence on a 1–4 scale.
  • Feedback will follow each trial.
